title: National Traders v. Kapil Dutta
text: The complainant, National Traders, filed a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act for dishonour of a cheque of Rs 9,80,000. The cheque was dishonoured with the remark 'Exceeds Arrangement'. The drawer, Kapil Dutta, raised a defence that the cheque was given as security and not for discharge of a debt. The court examined the written agreement between the parties which clearly records the debt. Under Section 139 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, there is a presumption in favour of the holder that the cheque was issued for a legally enforceable debt. The drawer failed to rebut this presumption. The dishonour of the cheque is established. The drawer is held guilty under Section 138 NI Act. Sentence: fine of Rs 20,00,000. The complainant is awarded the cheque amount with interest.
